name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
benefit_summary: Financial scholarship of ₹12,000/year for undergraduate degrees and ₹20,000/year for postgraduate courses to meritorious students.
who_can_apply_intro: All eligible citizens who meet the PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students guidelines.
required_documents: College Admission Receipt / Bonafide Student Certificate
application_steps: Check that your Aadhaar card and active bank passbook are ready.
Visit the official portal or your local Common Service Centre (CSC) / Panchayat office.
Fill in the application details and complete your biometric or OTP e-KYC.
Receive your application reference number to track verification and direct payment status.
